```typescript
router.add("POST", "/orders/:id/cancel", withCustomer(deps.sessions, (_req, params, customer) => {
  const order = deps.orders.get(params.id!);
  if (!order || order.customerId !== customer.id) return { status: 404, body: { error: "order not found" } };
  const cancelledOrder = cancel(order);
  deps.orders.save(cancelledOrder);
  return { status: 200, body: cancelledOrder };
}));
```

- Calls the domain `cancel()` function which enforces the rule: "only pending orders can be cancelled"
- Persists the cancelled order
- Returns 200 with the cancelled order
